hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/dist/*|*/.claude/*|*/components.d.ts) ;; *"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.vue|*"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.ts|*"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.js|*"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.scss|*"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.json) r="${f%%/umit-mobilya-client/*}/umit-mobilya-client"; "$r/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/dist/*|*/.claude/*|*/components.d.ts) exit 0;; *"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.vue|*"/umit-mobilya-client/"*.ts) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; w=""; case "$f" in */useFToast.ts) ;; *) grep -q "useToast(" "$f" && w="${w}useToast() called directly, use useFToast() from @/composables/useFToast. ";; esac; case "$f" in */plugins/axios.ts) ;; *) grep "response\.data" "$f" | grep -qv "error" && w="${w}response.data read again, the axios interceptor already returns the body (only error.response.data is valid). ";; esac; grep -qE "localStorage\.(get|set|remove)Item\((\x27|\")" "$f" && w="${w}Bare string passed to localStorage, use EStorageKeys from @/constants/storageKeys. "; [ -n "$w" ] || exit 0; jq -n --arg w "$w" --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage: ("Convention warning: " + $w), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Client convention check flagged " + $f + ": " + $w + "Fix it unless there is a deliberate reason not to.")}}'; }
